name: d4-testimonials
description: Customer testimonials: quotes with author, role, optional rating and photo, managed from the dashboard. Ships a reusable <Testimonials /> component any page can embed, a public /testimonials page, and Review structured data so ratings can appear in search results.
clientFacingSummary: Customer reviews you manage yourself: add a quote, who said it, and an optional star rating, and they appear on your site.
